method: Copied Git source candidates to an isolated directory, installed fresh Node and Python dependencies, then ran the full check. No original node_modules, .venv, .cache or dist was copied. This is a local restore test, not a second physical machine or browser test.
checks: validate:functions (186 filter combinations and all 1614 people)
validate:design (29 landscape source and release assets)
validate:portraits (1172 portraits, 2 styles and 6 extreme ratios)
executionNote: The H5 compiler required normal host permissions because the restricted macOS environment failed in system-configuration. The successful full check exited with code 0.
remoteCi: Configured separately in .github/workflows/ci.yml; this local report does not assert that remote CI or other operating systems have passed.
limitations: PC and mobile browser/device acceptance remains pending in QA.md.
